entries.title: 第 1 輪｜GCP e2-micro 免費方案限制與規格
entries.fact: GCP Free Tier 每月提供 1 個位於 us-west1、us-central1 或 us-east1 的 non-preemptible e2-micro 執行體、30 GB-months 標準磁碟與 1 GB 北美出站流量。
entries.quote: 1 non-preemptible e2-micro VM instance per month in one of the following US regions: Oregon: us-west1 . Iowa: us-central1 . South Carolina: us-east1 . 30 GB-months standard persistent disk. 1 GB of outbound data transfer from North America to all region destinations (excluding China and Australia) per month.

entries.title: 第 2 輪｜TastyIgniter 系統需求與環境依賴
entries.fact: TastyIgniter 安裝環境需求指定 PHP 8.3+ 以及 MySQL 8.0+ 或 MariaDB 10.6+ 資料庫。
entries.quote: PHP 8.3+ with extensions: bcmath, ctype, curl, dom, exif, gd, intl, json, mbstring, openssl, pdo_mysql, tokenizer, xml, zip MySQL 8.0+ or MariaDB 10.6+

entries.title: 第 3 輪｜PHP-FPM 進程管理器 static、ondemand 與 dynamic 行為定義
entries.fact: PHP-FPM 提供 static（固定子進程數）、ondemand（有請求時才生成進程且閒置被砍）與 dynamic（依負載動態調整子進程數）三種模式。
entries.quote: static - the number of child processes is fixed ( pm.max_children ). ondemand - the processes spawn on demand (when requested, as opposed to dynamic, where pm.start_servers are started when the service is started). The number of child processes is limited by pm.max_children , and idle processes are killed after pm.process_idle_timeout . dynamic - the number of child processes is set dynamically based on the following directives: pm.max_children , pm.start_servers , pm.min_spare_servers , pm.max_spare_servers .

entries.title: 第 4 輪｜MySQL 與 MariaDB innodb_buffer_pool_size 核心作用
entries.fact: innodb_buffer_pool_size 為重要系統變數，其大小應容納伺服器大部分活躍資料集以讓 SQL 請求直接在快取中運作。
entries.quote: The most important server system variable is innodb_buffer_pool_size . This size should contain most of the active data set of your server so that SQL request can work directly with information in the buffer pool cache.

entries.title: 第 5 輪｜ESC/POS 網路出單機 AppSocket 與 Port 9100 運作機制
entries.fact: AppSocket 網路列印通常使用 port 9100 並透過 socket 後端運作。
entries.quote: AppSocket printing normally happens over port 9100 and uses the socket backend.

entries.title: 第 6 輪｜Google Sheets API 批次請求配額計算與原子性
entries.fact: Google Sheets API 的 batch 請求（包含其子請求）在配額用量上限中被計算為單一 API 請求，且具備原子性：若任一請求無效則整批更新失敗。
entries.quote: Each batch request , including any subrequest, is counted as one API request toward your usage limit. All Sheets requests are applied atomically. That is, if any request is not valid then the entire update is unsuccessful and none of the (potentially dependent) changes are applied.

entries.title: 第 7 輪｜Meta Threads API 發文頻率與數量限制
entries.fact: Threads 個人檔案限制在連續 24 小時內透過 API 最多發佈 250 則貼文，發佈端點會強制執行此限制。
entries.quote: Threads 個人檔案限制在連續 24 小時內，API 只能發佈 250 則貼文。輪播廣告計為單一貼文。嘗試發佈影音素材容器時， POST /{threads-user-id}/threads_publish 端點會強制執行此限制。

entries.title: 第 8 輪｜Python PEP 686 預設啟用 UTF-8 模式規範
entries.fact: 提議預設啟用 UTF-8 mode，讓 Python 在檔案、標準輸入輸出與管道中一致使用 UTF-8 作為預設編碼。
entries.quote: This PEP proposes enabling UTF-8 mode by default. With this change, Python consistently uses UTF-8 for default encoding of files, stdio, and pipes.

entries.title: 第 9 輪｜Google Drive 電腦版同步模式切換與衝突資料防護
entries.fact: 切換同步模式前必須確保最近變更已完成同步以防止資料遺失，若從 Mirror 切換至 Stream 且在變更上傳完成前刪除舊本地資料夾將導致未同步檔案遺失。
entries.quote: To prevent data loss, always make sure your recent changes have finished syncing before you switch your sync mode. This is especially critical when changing from “Mirror” to “Stream.” If you delete your old local folder from Mirror mode before all your changes have been uploaded to the cloud, those un-synced files will be lost.

entries.title: 第 10 輪｜SQLite WAL 模式併發讀寫互不阻塞機制
entries.fact: WAL 模式提供更高併發度，讀取者不會阻塞寫入者，寫入者也不會阻塞讀取者，讀取與寫入可同時進行。
entries.quote: WAL provides more concurrency as readers do not block writers and a writer does not block readers. Reading and writing can proceed concurrently.
